name: flowhub-app
description: uTools 风格的桌面启动器：全局搜索目录/网页，回车打开；可配置启动本地应用。

scripts.pack: env -u GH_TOKEN -u GITHUB_TOKEN CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir
scripts.dist:mac: env -u GH_TOKEN -u GITHUB_TOKEN CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.release:mac: FLOWHUB_PUBLISH=1 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --publish always
